findings.title: Leaderboard list endpoint coerces 'viewed' status to Submitted (missing case arm)
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/vacancies/:id/applications (router.gleam:415) maps the DB status string to the enum but has no 'viewed' arm. A viewed row hits the unknown fallback, coerces to Submitted, and the leaderboard renders a slate Submitted pill at rank 0 with a warning-log spam per viewed row. AC4 'leaderboard rows ... render viewed' is violated on the main triage surface.
findings.recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` between the shortlisted and approved arms in application_list_handler.gleam (line ~89), matching parse_status and the shared codec.

findings.title: ApiReturnedStatusUpdate reducer keeps old status for 'viewed' (missing arm)
findings.evidence:
let updated_status = case new_status {
  "under_review" -> application.UnderReview
  "shortlisted" -> application.Shortlisted
  "approved" -> application.Approved
  "rejected" -> application.Rejected
  "auto_closed" -> application.AutoClosed
  _ -> app.status
}
findings.detail: The single funnel for every status PATCH lacks a 'viewed' arm, so a successful PATCH to viewed keeps the old status in the local model. On the detail route the immediate refetch corrects it (transient stepper flash + focus on a non-current stop); on refetch failure the UI stays stale until reload. Every other string->variant map in this PR gained the arm.
findings.recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` to the case in client.gleam:3128 (or replace the bespoke decoder with application.status_from_string, which already handles all seven values).

findings.title: Comparison CTA Viewed->Contact merge has no test; existing negative invariant is stale
findings.evidence:
column_headers.gleam:132 -> `application.Shortlisted | application.Viewed ->`
client_test.gleam:3518: `// Negative invariant: the Contact CTA testid (and the matching dock
// entry) is exposed only on the Shortlisted column.`
Seeds only Submitted/UnderReview/Rejected — no Viewed entry.
findings.detail: The deliberate routing change (Viewed merged into the Shortlisted Contact arm, both comparison surfaces) has zero coverage: removing `| application.Viewed` would not fail any test, and the existing negative test's documented invariant is now false.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a comparison-page test rendering an application.Viewed detail and asserting `comparison-cta-contact-<id>` and `dock-contact-<id>` render; update the stale comment in comparison_page_cta_contact_button_only_on_shortlisted_test.

findings.title: Stale pipeline-index count in slug_for_index doc comment (0..3, now 0..4)
findings.detail: The diff updated the module header and clamp_focus comments to five stops but missed this one. Behaviour is correct (clamp_focus bounds 0..4); only the comment is stale.
findings.recommended_fix: Change `(0..3)` to `(0..4)` in the slug_for_index doc comment.

findings.title: Stale '4-arm parse_status' reference in test doc comment (now 5-arm)
findings.evidence:
/// `submitted` must map to `Submitted`, not be coerced to the default. Guards
/// against accidentally mirroring the 4-arm `parse_status` (which omits it).
findings.detail: parse_status gained the viewed arm this PR (now 5 arms). The parallel comment in shared/application.gleam:207 was updated to '5-arm'; this one was not. Count-reference drift.

findings.title: status_pill recolour of UnderReview/Shortlisted/Approved has no pinning test
findings.evidence:
UnderReview: `bg-navy/10 text-navy` (was bg-amber)
Shortlisted: `bg-amber/10 text-amber` (was score-strong)
Approved: `bg-teal/10 text-teal` (was score-strong)
`rg -n 'status-pill-(under-review|shortlisted|approved)' client/test/` -> nothing
findings.detail: The new Viewed arm is pinned (status_pill_viewed_renders_navy_test) but the deliberate recolour of three existing statuses — a headline AC item — is not. A silent revert of any of the three colours would pass CI.
findings.recommended_fix: Add render assertions for UnderReview->navy, Shortlisted->amber, Approved->teal mirroring the Viewed pin.

findings.title: Server 400 message listing 'viewed' is not body-asserted
findings.evidence:
"Status must be one of: under_review, shortlisted, viewed, approved, rejected"
application_integration_test.gleam:235 asserts only `error_code.InvalidStatus`, never the message body.
findings.detail: parse_status acceptance is pinned (parse_status_viewed_test), but the 400 message text listing viewed is not. Informational; low regression risk.
findings.recommended_fix: Optionally assert the 400 body contains 'viewed' in the invalid-status integration test, or accept the parse_status unit pin as sufficient.

findings.title: leaderboard status_rank Viewed position is not exercised by any sort test
findings.evidence: sort_by_status_asc_test seeds only Rejected/Submitted/Shortlisted; comment still says 'Submitted (0) -> UnderReview (1) -> Shortlisted (2) -> Approved (3) -> Rejected (4)'.
findings.detail: Viewed=3 insertion is unobserved: the test passes under the old numbering, and its doc comment is stale (no Viewed, wrong Approved/Rejected positions).
findings.recommended_fix: Extend sort_by_status_asc_test with Shortlisted/Viewed/Approved entries asserting Viewed sorts between Shortlisted and Approved; refresh the comment.

findings.title: Stepper stop_tone and detail-page header pill viewed arms lack render assertions
findings.evidence:
`True, _, application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy text-white", "")`
`_, True, application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy/10 text-navy", "✓ ")`
`application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy/10 text-navy", "VIEWED")`
`rg -n 'stop_tone|view_status_pill' client/test/` -> only comment hits
findings.detail: Stepper logic (rank/clamp/focus/direction) is covered; these render arms are not. stop_tone has `_ ->` catch-alls so a missing viewed arm would not be a compile error.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a stepper render test asserting the viewed active stop carries bg-navy text-white, and a detail-page VIEWED pill assertion — or accept the status_pill Viewed pin as proxy.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.evidence: P0 paths FULL (codec round-trip, parse_status acceptance, PATCH->viewed + audit row). P1 logic FULL (rank/clamp/focus/direction). Gaps: comparison CTA merge (NONE), status_pill recolour (partial), status_rank viewed position, 400 message text, viewed render arms.
findings.detail: P0=100%, P1>=90%, overall ~75%: 3 of 9 behaviours have core coverage with untested render/secondary halves; the comparison-CTA merge is a deliberate routing change with zero coverage and a now-stale negative test.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the comparison-CTA-viewed test (the one material gap) and pin the status_pill recolour; that lifts overall above 80% and clears CONCERNS.

rejected_findings.title: sql.gleam adds Viewed type variant + encoder arm but no decoder arm
rejected_findings.reason: False positive: server/src/application/sql.gleam has no ApplicationStatus decoder — Squirrel decodes statuses as plain strings (AutoTransitionOnOpenRow/BulkRejectByIdsRow use decode.string), and DB reads map through shared application.status_from_string (application_detail_handler.gleam:996), which gained the viewed arm. Nothing is missing.
